title: A less expensive start to the school day
titleZh: 上学的一天，怎样少花一点钱
summaryZh: 从免费早餐到校服，理解一份2026年9月1日的英格兰家庭支持公告；保留“可能”“最多”等条件，不把上限当人人领取的金额。
levelReason: 围绕早餐、午餐、校服等具体生活场景；以现在时、过去时及could表达条件性帮助，少量政策词带注释。 编辑估计，非认证CEFR测评。

source.name: Department for Education / GOV.UK
source.title: Breathing space for families as government eases school costs

attribution: Adapted from Department for Education / GOV.UK, “Breathing space for families as government eases school costs”, published 2026-09-01. adaptation: 英语机构原文的同语言分级改写及逐句中文翻译；排除图片、标识、所有外部直接引语和链接报告。事实日期与整理日期分开；口语问题及表达为教学补充。原语判断依据机构署名及英语编辑语境，不声称认证作者母语。

sentences.text: Going back to school can be expensive for families in England.
sentences.zh: 在英格兰，返校可能给家庭带来不少开销。

glosses.note: 形容词，be expensive for对……来说费用高

sentences.text: Parents have to think about lunches, uniforms and care before or after lessons.
sentences.zh: 家长得考虑午餐、校服，以及上课前后照看孩子的问题。

glosses.note: 复数名词；此处指学生穿的统一服装。

sentences.text: On 1 September 2026, the Department for Education described several changes to help with these costs.
sentences.zh: 2026年9月1日，英国教育部介绍了几项帮助减轻这些费用的变化。

sentences.text: More children from families receiving Universal Credit can now get free school meals.
sentences.zh: 更多领取“统一福利金”家庭的孩子现在可以获得免费校餐。

glosses.note: 现在分词修饰families，表示领取某项福利的家庭。

sentences.text: The department also announced 1,400 new free breakfast clubs for the new term.
sentences.zh: 教育部还宣布，在新学期新增1400个免费早餐俱乐部。

glosses.note: 与日期明确的过去事件搭配，使用过去式。

sentences.text: These clubs give children a meal before lessons and can help parents with the morning routine.
sentences.zh: 这些俱乐部在上课前给孩子提供一餐，也能帮助家长安排早晨的事务。

glosses.note: 此处指早晨反复进行的活动

sentences.text: Another part of the support is about making school uniforms cheaper.
sentences.zh: 另一部分支持与降低校服费用有关。

glosses.note: 此处指帮助家庭的措施

sentences.text: Together, free meals, breakfast clubs and cheaper uniforms could save some families up to £1,200 a year.
sentences.zh: 免费校餐、早餐俱乐部及更便宜的校服结合起来，可能让一些家庭每年最多节省1200英镑。

glosses.note: 指前述几项措施综合起作用

sentences.text: This is a possible saving, not money that every family will receive.
sentences.zh: 这是一种可能的节省额，并不是每个家庭都会收到的一笔钱。

glosses.note: 可数名词单数，与a possible搭配。

sentences.text: The same announcement described around 450 new or larger school-based nurseries, with 9,000 childcare places.
sentences.zh: 同一公告还介绍了约450所新设或扩建的校内托幼机构，共提供9000个托幼名额。

sentences.text: The aim is to make mornings easier and reduce the cost of looking after young children.
sentences.zh: 目的是让早晨的安排更轻松，并降低照顾幼儿的费用。

words.note: 复数名词；此处指学生穿的统一服装。
现在分词修饰families，表示领取某项福利的家庭。
与日期明确的过去事件搭配，使用过去式。
可数名词单数，与a possible搭配。

sentences.note: could表示可能性；up to给出上限，两者都不能省略成“每个家庭必定节省”。
The aim is to +动词原形，说明一项安排的目的。

questions.text: Which school costs are hardest for families to manage?
questions.zh: 哪些上学费用最让家庭难以承担？

questions.text: How could a breakfast club change a family’s morning?
questions.zh: 早餐俱乐部可能怎样改变一个家庭的早晨？

expressions.text: This could help with the cost of childcare.
expressions.zh: 这可能帮助减轻托幼费用。
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是新闻原文引语。

expressions.text: The biggest cost for a family may be…
expressions.zh: 一个家庭最大的开销可能是……
expressions.note: 教学补充，用于讨论本文，不是新闻原文引语。
